messages.en: Sure. I'll pick you up at your place at seven, okay?

collocations.en: have the authority to make decisions

messages.en: Only the department head can approve this application, right?
Yes, I sent it to them this morning.
Just outside the station, at eight. Don't be late, okay!

senses.en_definition: To happen, occur or be in progress.
To act or behave in a particular way.
To act as or serve the function of someone or something.
To be valid or officially recognized as acceptable.
To be in force or apply to particular people or circumstances.

messages.en: What happened outside the shop earlier? I saw a crowd there. Is everyone okay?
Someone fell off their motorbike earlier, but they weren't hurt. People were just helping them pick the bike up.
Oh, that's a bit of a relief. I thought it was serious. Good thing they're okay.
